hypothesis: The clean Blood tank window does not prove a Blood priority or eligibility edge. tank_threat_300 enables the six-target AoE lane and the loaded profile correctly contains Death Strike 49998 and Heart Strike 55050 in bucket 1, while the adapter compares elapsed multi-target DPS against the single-target simulator DPS reference and the harness applies reference_hard_floor even when reference_condition_compatibility is false. The first broken edge is therefore the role-calibration reference contract, which must be made explicit before class-policy tuning.
forbidden_changes: Do not change WoWSims or reference catalog data.
Do not change the Blood SQL migration, native candidate comparator, spell coefficients, gear, stats, encounter behavior, route, target geometry or safety policy.
Do not make incompatible tank reference evidence pass as actor or raid performance acceptance.
Do not remove Heart Strike fallback or multi-target Blood Boil behavior.
Do not close actor_30002 or any other open parent requirement from the contract test.
acceptance_conditions: A focused test proves that an otherwise clean tank_threat_300 record with incompatible reference conditions is classified as non-comparable rather than as a Blood throughput failure.
The tank-specific checks remain mandatory and unchanged: stance, TPS, snap/add threat, hostile retention, threat aura, healer exposure, mitigation, smoothing, survival and interrupts.
A comparable tank record still applies the configured hard reference floor and remains capable of failing it.
Independent review, gate-bearing build and one exact cleaned role run remain required; actor and raid acceptance remain separate.
